comment: NosK works in tandem with NosI and NosJ to perform the post-translational modification.

reactions.description: Attaches 3-methyl-2-indolic acid (MIA) via through S-MIAylation to Cys8 in the nosiheptin biosynthetic pathway. Current knowledge indicates that the full leader peptide is required for substrate recognition.
Attachment of MIA to Cys of the modified NosM precursor peptide.
